Class HistoricalCalibrationSpatialEvaluator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.HistoricalCalibrationSpatialEvaluator
public final class HistoricalCalibrationSpatialEvaluator extends Object
Spatial, Cartographic, and Root-Cause Drift Evaluator for Calibration Scenarios.

Extracted from HistoricalScenarioCalibrationHarness to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Evaluates dense intermediate checkpoints, computes Haversine distances, compares cartographic raster layers, and generates root-cause drift diagnoses with parameter tuning multipliers.

Version:
1.0.0-academic
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
